title: Nahum 1: chapter overview
paragraphs: The justice and power of the Lord.

outline.text: The justice and power of the Lord.

context: This prophet denounces the certain and approaching destruction of the Assyrian empire, particularly of Nineveh, which is described very minutely.
attribution: Matthew Henry, Concise Commentary (public domain). Historical Protestant interpretation; other traditions may read these passages differently.
